key.name: debug-logging
key.description: Read when the extension is enabled. Errors are always logged.

key.name: blur-filter-enabled
key.description: Enable the selected blur filter independently of glass distortion.

key.name: blur-method
key.description: Box blur, Fast Gaussian Blur, or lightweight Kawase with diagonal four-sample passes. Kawase approximates the blur with a different kernel.

key.name: blur-resolution
key.description: Automatic radius-based resolution, half or quarter of that resolution along each axis. Smaller textures reduce filter work at the expense of detail. Applies to Box, Gaussian and Kawase live captures; cached wallpaper effects retain their resolution.

key.name: blur-refresh-rate
key.description: Maximum capture/filter update rate as a percentage of each monitor's refresh rate: full, half or quarter. Reuses the prepared texture between updates. Geometry and filter changes refresh immediately. One trailing refresh preserves the final background after motion; no polling loop. Screenshots always capture fresh pixels. Requires an introspectable monitor refresh rate. Does not throttle the interface or cached wallpaper.

key.name: blur-render-area
key.description: Compatible monitor redraws, or experimental native element redraws including filter margins. An incomplete source uses the cached image while requesting its region for the next frame, which may add one frame of blur latency. Unsupported APIs fall back to compatible redraws. Static wallpaper panels do not need this guard.

key.name: blur-samples
key.description: 5, 9 or 13 taps, using 3, 5 or 7 linear texture reads per direction. Box and Kawase ignore this setting.

key.name: blur-iterations
key.description: Each iteration adds one horizontal and one vertical pass with decreasing steps. Four iterations use eight passes. Radius is normalized across iteration counts. Box and Kawase ignore this setting.

key.name: blur-kawase-iterations
key.description: Each iteration adds one diagonal four-sample GPU pass. The default three preserves the first beta. Steps are normalized to keep the blur intensity close across iteration counts. Independent of Gaussian iterations.

key.name: refraction-enabled
key.description: Refract the background independently of blur.

key.name: frosted-glass-enabled
key.description: Shared translucent texture. Does not capture or blur the background.

key.name: appearance-controls-version
key.description: Internal one-time upgrade marker.

key.name: blur-mode
key.description: Dynamic blurs the live backdrop. Refraction captures and distorts the live backdrop on the GPU. Combined glass applies the selected GPU blur before refraction. Economical uses a shared translucent frosted texture without capturing or blurring the backdrop.

key.name: blur-glass-method
key.description: GPU separable box blur or Fast Gaussian Blur, applied before glass refraction.

key.name: refraction-strength
key.description: Logical-pixel displacement of the live background. Used when glass distortion is enabled.

key.name: blur-backend
key.description: auto selects a supported backend; native uses Shell.BlurEffect; lightweight requires a capability-checked optional backend; off disables blur.

key.name: blur-radius
key.description: Logical pixels; adapter must account for monitor scale and backend API.

key.name: blur-brightness
key.description: Background brightness only; text and icons remain unchanged.

key.name: surface-opacity
key.description: Background alpha only; never use actor opacity on text or icons.

key.name: update-frequency
key.description: Requested maximum blur capture rate in Hz. Zero means compositor-driven. Effective only if the backend supports throttling; never create a polling redraw loop.

key.name: resize-debounce-ms
key.description: Trailing debounce for geometry changes, not for driving animations.

key.name: panel-opacity
key.description: Normal panel background alpha.

key.name: panel-maximized-opacity
key.description: Panel background alpha when a window is maximized on its monitor.

key.name: panel-fullscreen-opacity
key.description: Panel background alpha when a window is fullscreen on its monitor.

key.name: gtk-background-opacity
key.description: Requested selective GTK background alpha; requires application-side integration.

key.name: dock-opacity
key.description: Dock background alpha.

key.name: shadow-opacity
key.description: Icon shadow alpha.

key.name: shadow-radius
key.description: Icon shadow blur radius in logical pixels.

key.name: shadow-offset-x
key.description: Horizontal icon shadow offset in logical pixels.

key.name: shadow-offset-y
key.description: Vertical icon shadow offset in logical pixels.

key.name: panel-style
key.description: theme preserves theme colors; light and dark request explicit background styles.

key.description: Use only the wallpaper behind the panel and cache the filtered result. Windows are not captured. Wallpaper, monitor, geometry and effect changes update the cache.
